  • Ceasefire status: Fragile. France24 flags renewed strikes threatening US-Iran pause.
  • Maritime / Strait of Hormuz: Iran allows passage for select friendly states (Russia, India, China) and blocks others. Tactical: selective access increases political leverage and risk to global shipping.
  • Air & Movements: Flight scans show ~650–690 aircraft in region; at least 2–3 military tracks observed (including RCH149, CNV5426). Continued military air activity consistent with sustained campaign tempo.
  • Tech / Force Multipliers: Russia claims a strike-UAV industry nearing parity with its nuclear industry (TASS). Tactical implication: more accessible combat UAVs for state and proxy forces.
  • Information environment: Iran tightening post-war internet controls. Media reports of escalating censorship and user risk.
  • 🟢 Good News: US announced a second pause and Pakistan is mediating — a diplomatic opening remains.

Threat assessment:

  • Escalating — strikes continue despite a pause and the northern front remains active.

  • Active strikes/sirens: Israeli drone strike killed a girl in a Gaza safe zone. Israeli/US airstrikes continue on Iran. Hezbollah launches daily missile/rocket strikes on Israel’s northern border. Israeli strikes reported in southern Lebanon.
  • Ceasefire pause / diplomacy: Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET — claiming Iranian request and “talks going well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Tactical context: first 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr; current pause fragile.

  • Civilian impact: Confirmed civilian casualties in Gaza from drone strike. Displacement and infrastructure damage reported across border towns. Information controls increasing in Iran.
  • International actions: Pakistan mediating. Some countries (Russia/India/China) granted Hormuz access — operational divergence among major powers. No large troop deployments or new sanctions reported in last 48h.
  • 🟢 Good News: A formal 10-day pause is in place — creates a limited window for talks and reduced energy-targeting risk if respected.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — high risk of further violations and wider spillover.
